purpose: Development qualification of information value, observer advantage and probe increment; not a confirmatory final study or a TACL readiness claim.
sample: 40 user-approved, purposively selected facts; ten in each of four relations. Subject/declared alias and full unordered answer triples screened against old100 and one another; answers/topics may overlap.
review: Submitted workbook records approvals under Alex Miller. Identity and review independence were not independently verified. Preserve original workbook bytes and notes; no two-reviewer agreement claim.
old_data: 900 cases, 100 items, 57 connected groups, three known targets. Legacy grouping and folds preserved. Old100 factual re-review remains unverified. Old aggregates were checked in prior audit; this package refits without loading old model pickles.
Mistral: Reporter only; no held-out target transfer claim.
Y: (mean logp(C)-mean logp(P)) under C_document minus the same contrast under matched P_document. Each condition averages six answer-label permutations.
recorded_answer: Largest mean label log-support under C_document, with deterministic P,C,I tie order. Reports use a fresh stateless prompt; same model weights do not retain original activations.
source_report: Three document/prior, both/prior, uncertain/prior ALRs; average four label rotations then both ownership labels. The two labels are prompt manipulations, not proof of provenance.
candidate_interface: TFIDF and MPNet text contains target, question, document, recorded answer and all three candidate strings in SHA256 string order without P/C/I labels. Reporter query retains the same question/document/recorded-answer interface used in old100.
visible_features: Relation onehot4, strength onehot3, two nested old100 text forecasts. No no-document scores or factual reference labels.
probe_features: Visible plus actual recorded answer vs other alternatives mean no-document score, document entity vs other alternatives mean score, and normalized three-alternative entropy. Six no-document permutations reused over strengths; invariant to swapping factual-reference and irrelevant role designations.
reference_ceiling: Visible plus factual-reference-aware answer role onehot3 and no-document P-minus-C margin. Separate ceiling, never a public-input baseline.
training: Grouped nested TFIDF Ridge and MPNet Ridge forecasts; alpha in [0.1,1,10,100], 3 inner folds; 5 original outer folds for GB observer selection. All source/reporter decoder fits are target-specific, calibrated on identical old100 cases. Old100 final fits use nested out-of-fold forecasts for decoder training.
decoder: Primary GB: 100 trees, depth2, learning rate0.05, squared error, seed20261020; Ridge alpha1 sensitivity. Train-only standardization. No fresh hyperparameter tuning.
observer_selection: For each target exclude source model and choose minimum old100 group-heldout GB visible-tier MSE; lexical tie-break. Freeze selection and full old100 fits before any fresh scoring. Same selected observer used for Ridge sensitivity.
secondary: Self-only vs probe-only cost comparison, probe+selected observer, reference-aware ceiling, individual targets, Ridge sensitivity.
normalization: Per-case paired squared-error reduction divided by target old100 population Y variance. Average equally over the complete balanced targets and strengths. Larger is better for the named new policy.
uncertainty: 10000 bootstrap samples of the forty whole fresh groups (all nine cases together), percentile 95% descriptive intervals, fixed seed20261020. No confirmatory multiple-testing claim.
practical_screen: Proposed engineering threshold: normalized MSE improvement at least0.01 and positive in at least two targets. Not a validated scientific minimum, significance test, automatic study go/no-go, or journal admission rule.
cost: Visible0, self24, observer24, probe6, joint30 forward calls per target/item across three strengths. Given question/document/recorded answer and audit Y excluded from inference comparison. Different model calls have unequal compute; report model-specific successful forward tokens/time, loads and CPU preparation. Full billing needs entire runtime elapsed usage.
planning: 1.158308984633345 A100 forward hours based on prior qualified per-phase/model reference; initial two-hour allocation is planning only, excludes downloads, load, CPU fit, retries and review.
freeze: Automatic exhaustive outcome-blind token and qualified continuation audit, all1980 candidate-aware text embeddings, observer selection and old100 models hashed before fresh scoring. Local timestamped freeze, not external registration. Immutable checkpoint binding; resume never refits after outcomes.
later_study: Once inspected Fresh40 is development data and must be excluded from later confirmation. Recalibrate final sample size after revised contrasts; no fixed N claim yet.
